scripts.build:control: npm run build --workspace @limeiot/console && npm run build --workspace @limeiot/admin
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test tests/e2e.test.mjs tests/nas.test.mjs tests/device-identity.test.mjs
scripts.test:ios: npm run build && node tools/test-native.mjs ios
scripts.test:android: npm run build && node tools/test-native.mjs android

scripts.test:console: npm run build && npm run build:control && node tools/test-control.mjs --control-web
scripts.test:control:cli: npm run build && node --test tests/control-cli-boundaries.test.mjs && node tools/test-control.mjs --control-cli
scripts.test:models: npm run build:home && npm run build:control && node --test tests/model-validation-boundaries.test.mjs tests/model-compatibility-boundaries.test.mjs tests/model-release-boundaries.test.mjs tests/model-publication-boundaries.test.mjs tests/model-registry-boundaries.test.mjs && node tools/test-control.mjs --models

scripts.test:ota:sign: cargo build --locked -p limeiot-model-validator --bin limeiot-ota && node --test tests/ota-sign.test.mjs
scripts.test:ota:publish: cargo build --locked -p limeiot-model-validator --bin limeiot-ota && node --test tests/ota-publish.test.mjs

scripts.test:actions: npm run build && node --test tests/command-receipts.test.mjs tests/actions.test.mjs tests/actions-web.test.mjs

scripts.test:tv-agent: cargo build --workspace --locked && sh apps/android/gradlew --no-daemon -p apps/tv-agent :core:test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/tv-agent.test.mjs tests/tv-agent-composition.test.mjs
